name: CoNLL-2003: Named Entity Recognition Benchmark
description: The CoNLL-2003 shared task dataset is the standard benchmark for language-independent named entity recognition (NER). It contains English and German Reuters news stories annotated with four types of named entities: persons (PER), organizations (ORG), locations (LOC), and miscellaneous names (MISC). The English corpus comprises 1,393 news stories spanning 301,418 tokens across standard train, dev, and test splits.
